name: blockvectra
description: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP for blockchain docs, chain discovery and permitted public EVM RPC reads; indexed Data API requires a key and applicable usage limits.

http.description: Hosted MCP. Start without headers for docs and allowed public RPC; configure a private x-api-key header for indexed Data API/account tools.

examples.title: Discover a network and perform a public RPC read
examples.description: Choose mainnet or testnet explicitly, inspect the public method policy and report a permitted read result.
examples.prompt: Read the Robinhood Chain RPC guide, use list_chains to choose the required network, and check get_method_info before using rpc_call for eth_chainId with params []. Report the network and observation time. Stop if this method needs a key; do not sign or broadcast.
